summary.text: Benny Shendo Jr. is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2013, representing District 22, which covers parts of Bernalillo, McKinley, Rio Arriba, Sandoval and San Juan counties.
Shendo is vice chair of the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Shendo's occupation as community development and a district office at Jemez Pueblo.
Between sessions, Shendo is a member of the Legislative Finance Committee and the Indian Affairs Committee.
